nome_en: Maximum the Ryokun (Storm Awakening MAXIMUM Shinra Banshou)
nome_jp: マキシマムザ亮君(暴天覚醒MAXIMUM神羅曼象)
testo:
■ Neo Evolution: You may put it on one of your creatures that doesn't have "・" in its name. (If a creature is under it, treat it as a Neo Evolution Creature.)
Triple Breaker
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, destroy all creatures that have "・" in their names.
■ Your opponent can't cast spells that have "・" in their names.
testo_jp:
■ NEO進化：自分の、名前に《・》を含まないクリーチャー1体の上に置いてもよい。
Triple Breaker
■ このクリーチャーがバトルゾーンに出た時、名前に《・》とあるクリーチャーをすべて破壊する。
■ 相手は名前に《・》とある呪文を唱えられない。
